CAN.what_is_CAN: CAN is Citizen Access Number required to avail all e-Sevai services offered by various departments through TNeGA.
CAN.how_to_create_CAN: The official FAQ states that CAN is required for e-Sevai services and the official e-Sevai portal provides CAN registration/access.
CAN.forgotten_CAN: Search using Mobile number, date of Birth, Name, or Email id.

login_registration.registration: Register as a New User in the e-Sevai Citizen Portal.
login_registration.login: Use the registered login credentials in Citizen Login.

application_status.how_to_check_status: After logging in, go to the Check Status tab and enter the application number.

grievances_complaints.how_to_submit: Use the official e-Sevai Grievances/Complaints page.
